messages.text:
I received this miner and it has worked fine until recently when I did the firmware update and it switched to a new OS and firmware and the Hashrate dropped to around 47 to 50 MH/s. Please let me know if you can assist. Thannk you.

See screenshot that is attached.

Stephen P.
Note to the team: Handing this to our technical specialist now.

I'll try it
Thx
Sent from my iPhone

Hi Stephen,

Sounds good. Flash the new Hammer OS build from that link, let it come back up, and give it ten or fifteen minutes to settle before you read the hashrate.

If it lands back near 330 MH/s, you are done. If it is still sitting in the 50s, reply here with a fresh screenshot of the dashboard and the first lines of the Logs page after the restart, and JD will take it from there.

Good luck with it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Note to the team: Passing this to our technical specialist to answer.

Great news and thanks, I look forward to hearing from you again when there is a resolution.

Stephen P.
Handed to the team · Firmware route exhausted, fault needs JD / RMA approval

Hi Stephen,

Thanks, and thank you for the patience through all the testing. You have done everything we asked and the unit is still not where it should be, so this one is now with JD, our hardware lead, along with your log, your screenshots and the fact that 3.0.1 did not change anything.

He is offline over the weekend and picks it up Monday at 10am ET. His answer comes straight to you in this thread, so there is nothing you need to do in the meantime. You can leave the miner running as it is.

If you want to get ahead of it, JD is on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and goes by @nullhashrate there, and he is usually quick to reply.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
